page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 40 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.8 GB of RAM per core, and has a 35 MB L3 cache. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the middle tier across multiple tests. It achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 2133.36 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. In application-specific benchmarks, the instance handles 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and delivers a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning tasks, it processes 1841.39 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M model, dropping to 56.94 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge offers dedicated CPU allocation and a high clock speed, making it a solid choice for compute-intensive workloads that require predictable performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. Because it lacks local storage, users must provision external block storage, which should be factored into the overall resource architecture. This instance is well-suited for workloads such as software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
